title: feat: require more Bee Census answers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes "What are you making?", "Where else do you get AI?", "What stops you spending?" and "What would you pay for?" required.
- GitHub checkbox groups can't require at least one tick, so these become required multi-select dropdowns ("Pick all that apply"). Each keeps an escape answer.
- Makes "Where exactly did you find us?" required; channel detail is the most useful traction data.
- Renames the would-pay "None" option to "Nothing for now", because GitHub reserves "None" in dropdowns.
- Conditional follow-ups, the roast and the call handle stay optional.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The census asks a little more
gist.blurb: The Bee Census now collects a few more answers, including exactly where people found the hive. The optional roast remains optional.
gist.summary: The Bee Census now requires answers about what people are making, where else they get AI, what stops them spending, what they would pay for, and exactly where they found Pollinations; checkbox groups became required multi-select dropdowns with escape answers.
gist.impact: Census responses will include more consistent project and discovery-channel details, while conditional follow-ups, the roast, and the call handle remain optional.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping fill out a GitHub-style Bee Census form on a cozy CRT, with several selected dropdown answers and a small map showing a path to the hive. Flowers and code-plants keep the survey scene warm rather than bureaucratic.
